metadataRaw.title: One Move to Quickly Realign Your Back and Hips
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates a simple and effective stretch to release tight muscles that may be misaligning your back and hips, especially if one hip feels uneven (higher or lower).

No equipment is required, and you can do it at home. You may see results in as little as 30 seconds.

Give it a try and let us know how it works for you!
